'''Light sensors''' were a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. [[Sensor beacon/Legends|Sensor beacons]], such as [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech's]] [[SE-Vigilant automated sensor beacon]], were equipped with light sensors as part of their [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]].<ref name="EGWT" /> [[Seeker (droid)/Legends|Seekers]] were equipped with light and [[Heat detector|heat sensors]] that allowed them to track targets.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Tagge Seeker}}</ref>
